note: Audited 18 next-tier solve, forcing, coupling, hot-start, and analysis files; findings below are only candidates that survived caller and neutralizer tracing. The 12 first-pass files named by the requester were excluded.

reason: The Holland and CLE15 active-storm calls pass different swapped argument orders, but both cause the helper to store latitude in EyeLon and longitude in EyeLat. The calm branches are correct, and no later correction occurs before sector-based wind drag consumes the coordinates.

At a mesh node exactly at the storm eye, sphericalDistance returns zero, so alpha divides by zero and the velocity radical evaluates an infinity-times-zero product that yields NaN. There is no radius epsilon or eye-node special case before the forcing is returned.

reason: Under NFOVER=1, all four invalid harmonic-output selectors are announced as reset to zero, but none is actually assigned. No later normalization occurs, so the invalid values remain active in harmonic/output selection logic.

A repeated or collinear STWAVE triangle has totalarea=0; for a collinear target the inclusion test accepts 0<=0 and immediately divides by zero to form radiation-stress weights. No area epsilon or degenerate-cell rejection neutralizes either triangle path.
